article.title: Titan (moon)
article.text:
# Titan (moon)

| table |

**Titan** is the largest moon of Saturn. It has a thick atmosphere. Huygens landed there in 2005 after a long cruise aboard Cassini, which had launched in 1997 and arrived at Saturn in 2004; the descent took about two and a half hours and the probe sent data from the surface for about seventy minutes before its batteries ran out, longer than planned, giving scientists images of river channels.
